annotations.title: Keyword density: top keywords and phrases of a text or page

description: Keyword density of a text or a web page: the most frequent words and two-word phrases (English stop words removed), each with its count and share of all words, plus total and unique word counts. Give text, or a URL whose readable text is used (HTML, up to 1 MB). Use for SEO copy checks, comparing a page against a target keyword, or summarising what a page is about; for readability use text_stats. Example: text=Agents pay per call. Agents pay with USDC. Pay per call tools for agents.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

text.description: The text (up to 50,000 characters); or give url instead

top.description: How many keywords and phrases to return, 1-50 (default 15)

url.description: A page URL to analyse instead of text

name: text_keyword_density
